Job Description

The intern will conduct hands-on research at the intersection of machine learning, statistics, and critical energy infrastructure security. The position focuses on enhancing the reliability, transparency, and operator-readiness of AI-driven cybersecurity tools used to secure power grid substations and physical assets, with a primary focus on explainability and robust uncertainty bounds.

· Explainable AI (XAI): Design and implement XAI methods (e.g., attribution maps, rule extraction, root-cause analyses) to make complex ML models transparent and auditable for control-room operators and system administrators.

· Confidence & Uncertainty Quantification: Apply statistical techniques and frameworks (e.g., conformal prediction, Bayesian neural networks, or ensemble methods) to quantify model confidence and measure predictive uncertainty in real-time.

· Grid Dataset Analysis: Analyze cyber-physical power system security datasets (such as 9-Bus system baseline and cyber-physical anomaly runs) to extract feature patterns and validate anomaly detection model behavior.

· Model Safety & Robustness: Explore machine learning safety techniques, including model steering, to ensure grid security models behave predictably under distribution shifts or input corruptions.

· Visualization & Alert Design: Support research into visualization methods and alert design that present explainability and confidence metrics clearly to operators, assisting with alert prioritization.

· Collaboration & Reporting: Partner with cybersecurity researchers and AI development teams to integrate explainability modules, document results, and compile guidelines for deploying reliable AI models.

.

Meta is seeking Research Interns to join the FM Quality ML team within Facebook Ads Ecosystem. FM Quality sits at the intersection of machine learning and system optimization across Meta's family of apps. We answer three fundamental questions: how many ads to show, which ads are best for each person, and how to deliver them, balancing revenue growth with user experience. Our team applies state-of-the-art ML, Generative AI, Reinforcement Learning, and large-scale systems to personalize ad quality across Feed, Videos, Reels, and Stories. Our interns will have the opportunity to frame practical, high-impact ads quality problems as rigorous machine learning problems, and bring their own expertise to build innovative solutions under the guidance of our research scientists and software engineers.

The central research challenge is to build a quality system that understands each person and each ad deeply enough to reason about long-term user value, and to show people the ads they will like and trust. People tell us about their ad experience through many quality signals, such as survey ratings, hiding or reporting an ad, and their experience after a click. Each signal captures only part of the picture, and their effects add up across a session and over weeks. We are post-training large language models into a quality foundation model that reasons over a person's ad and organic interaction history together with the ad's content, and returns both an explanation grounded in that history and calibrated predictions for many quality signals at once. Open problems include post-training recipes and reward design that make reasoning measurably improve prediction and calibration, representing ads and user behavior in a shared semantic vocabulary the model can reason over, evaluating reasoning against people's own judgments, and distilling the model's reasoning into efficient production models that serve within strict latency and compute constraints. Offline evaluation and online experiments help us connect model improvements to better ad experiences and long-term value for people and advertisers.

If you are excited about using LLM reasoning to help billions of people see ads they like and trust, come join us!
